column1: # Files renamed so that no two paths differ only by case (the repository
# works on case-insensitive file systems). One line per file:
# stored path<TAB>original path. Contents unchanged. The legacy bench
# restores the original names in its private copy of an application when
# keeps the tree free of new collisions; tests/restore_case.sh rebuilds the
# original layout (on a case-sensitive file system).
